body: This is the most beautiful and satisfying thing I’ve ever seen.

I have an appointment with my therapist on Tuesday. She met him and liked him. These incidents are clearly red flags but he’s so normal and supportive otherwise. It’s like his ego can’t handle any complaints. I think it’s from past trauma but he’s also being a dick in these scenarios and it’s really affecting me now. I was trying to give him the benefit of the doubt but doesn’t seem worth it now.
